summary.text: Joe Angelino is the incumbent Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 121 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired Norwich police chief and Marine Corps veteran, he was first elected to the Assembly in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Angelino, a lifelong resident of Central New York, rose from police officer to sergeant and then Chief of Police of the Norwich Police Department, a post he held for nearly 20 years; from 2006 to 2008 he also served as the city's Fire Chief.

He enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps in 1985, served as a tank commander in Desert Storm and as an infantry first sergeant during the 2003 Iraq invasion and again in 2005, received two Purple Heart medals, and retired from the Marine reserves as a Sergeant Major in 2008.
He is a volunteer firefighter with the G.L. Rider Hook & Ladder Company of the Norwich Fire Department.
Angelino was elected to the Assembly on November 3, 2020, and represents parts of Broome, Chenango, Delaware, Madison and Otsego counties.

He is a member of the Codes; Corporations, Authorities and Commissions; Ethics and Guidance; Oversight, Analysis and Investigation; Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports Development; and Veterans' Affairs committees.
His official biography says he works on issues including law enforcement, veterans and the middle class, and that he lives in Norwich with his wife, Kendall Saber.
